## About 

I'm a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the [Institute for Advanced Study in Toulouse](https://www.iast.fr/people/joshua-weiner) at the [Toulouse School of Economics](https://www.tse-fr.eu/). Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Centre for International Conflict - Analysis and Management [(CICAM)](https://www.ru.nl/cicam/) at Radboud University's [Department of Political Science](https://www.ru.nl/en/departments/nijmegen-school-of-management/political-science) and a [Civil War Paths Fellow](https://www.civilwarpaths.org/) at the University of York's Centre for the Comparative Study of Civil War. I received my Ph.D. in [Political Science](https://politics.ubc.ca/) from the University of British Columbia (UBC) in 2024. My work has been published or is forthcoming in *World Development*, *Journal of Peace Research*, *International Studies Quarterly*, *Journal of Global Security Studies*, and *Civil Wars*.

My research sits at the intersection of international relations and comparative politics. Much of my work is on the political economy of civil war and political violence, where I study questions related to armed group behavior, rebel governance, armed group leaders, and conflict dynamics. Questions currently motivating my work include: 1) how do armed group funding strategies impact group behavior and governance; and 2) how do armed groups adapt during long conflicts. 

In another stream of research, I am a coauthor on multiple research papers and projects that analyze the internal dynamics of international organizations (IOs), aid agencies, and foreign policy bureaucracies. Across both research agendas, I have collected original observational, survey, and archival data, and I employ a variety of methods in my own and coauthored work including quasi-experiments, survey experiments, and text as data approaches. Geographically, I concentrate on the Global South, specifically the Middle East and Africa.

My research has been funded by the Netherlands' [Dutch Research Council (NWO)](https://www.nwo.nl/en/researchprogrammes/open-competition-ssh) and Canada's [Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)](https://www.nserc-crsng.gc.ca/Students-Etudiants/PG-CS/CGSD-BESCD_eng.asp).

Feel free to contact me at [joshua.weiner\@tse-fr.eu](mailto:joshua.weiner@tse-fr.eu) for more information about my research or teaching.
:::
